name: CompSC literature-curated conventional-superconductor structures and EPC parameters
description: Literature-computed electron–phonon parameters linked to atomic structures curated by Tran and Vu for conventional-superconductor machine learning. The public corrected release contains periodic structures and pressure-dependent targets.
version: May 2023 dataset; duplicate removed August 2024; repository revision ec5411ca41a0726cad01324609ed34940c9e20ab
count_display: 586 atomic structures; 583 values of lambda and 566 values of omega_log after August 2024 duplicate removal
count_scope: Corrected CompSC/202305 public CSV and poscar.tgz at pinned repository revision; 586 rows and 586 regular POSCAR files, including multiple pressures/structures for a composition.
license: Not verified; no repository license file or data license statement found.

sources.title: CompSC author README, corrected release
sources.evidence: Author documents original 587 structures and the August 2024 duplicate removal, leaving 586 structures, 583 lambda values and 566 omega_log values.

sources.title: CompSC released CSV
sources.evidence: Direct parse: 586 rows with 272 distinct composition strings; 583 numeric Lambda values and 566 numeric omlog values. 584 pressures parse numerically, spanning 0–800; two pressure cells contain filename-like strings.

sources.title: CompSC released periodic structures
sources.evidence: In-memory archive listing contains exactly 586 regular files named struct-*.vasp; no extraction needed.

sources.title: Machine-learning approach for discovery of conventional superconductors
sources.evidence: Tran and Vu, Physical Review Materials 7, 054805 (31 May 2023): predicts lambda and omega_log from structures; Tc is computed afterward rather than supplied as experimental ground truth.

caveats: Targets are literature-computed EPC parameters, not experimental Tc measurements; composition repeats across pressure and structural cases.
The 2024 ACS review reports the earlier 587-structure cohort; the public corrected denominator is 586.

The pressure column has two nonnumeric cells (IDs 567 and 568: 270Pa.vasp and 300Pa.vasp). Numeric values reach 800; do not impose the review’s historical up-to-500-GPa description on the released file.
Missing lambda and omega_log labels are distinct from zero. A downstream Tc estimate requires a specified formula and Coulomb pseudopotential.
Public downloading does not establish redistribution rights.
